layerDefinitions.FUNDAMENTAL_DATA_ENGINE: Source qualification, normalization, exact mapping, availability, conflict/revision lineage, mechanical derivation and deterministic snapshot.
layerDefinitions.INVESTMENT_JUDGMENT: Normalized earnings/tax/EBITDA adjustments and investment judgments.
layerDefinitions.QUALITATIVE_ANALYST_REVIEW: Reviewed issuer capex/cash classifications and rubric judgments.
layerDefinitions.SCORING: Human rubric assessment and approved scoring admission.
layerDefinitions.SCORING_INPUT_PREPARATION: Historical endpoints and compatible metric inputs; minimum three-year trend does not require a fourth trend year.
layerDefinitions.VALUATION: Expected returns, valuation assumptions and enterprise/equity denominators.

scopeBasis: Reported raw financial facts stay data-engine responsibilities. FY2022 supporting history and reviewed economic adjustments remain scoring/analyst work. No ownership label erases an exact pinned requirement.
